tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Compact latest election results and polling averages, with source dates and result status.

tools.name: list_elections
tools.description: List available elections with exact IDs and dates, including both 2019 elections.

tools.name: get_election
tools.description: National party votes, seats, turnout and editorial blocs for one election.

tools.name: get_polls
tools.description: Final-week average, retrospective model, initial exit polls, result and recent individual polls. Eligible poll dates are fieldwork end dates. include_publication_only adds excluded records with unconfirmed fieldwork_end and the 2026 publisher channel aliases.

tools.name: search_localities
tools.description: Find CBS locality codes by name in Hebrew, Russian, English or Arabic. Use the code with get_locality.

tools.name: get_locality
tools.description: Locality votes, parties, blocs and turnout; identifies combined reporting units and unavailable historical results.

tools.name: get_sources
tools.description: Primary source URLs, verification timestamps and hashes, raw downloads and collaboration contact.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: National/locality aggregate analytics, fixed classifications, correctly defined historical bloc changes and medians. include_cities adds the UI’s latest-size-selected city matrix; missing results stay null.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.description: Discover structured immigrant reported-vote studies, pre-election intentions and source-reference-only research. Different participants are not a panel trend.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Read one published study with its own dates, group sample sizes, exact rounded respondent percentages and sampling limitations. Source-only entries have no invented result table.

tools.name: get_immigration
tools.description: New-immigration registry flows by available year, country and receiving-locality label. Not current population, language or individual voting. Unavailable years are not zero.

tools.name: get_demographics
tools.description: CBS Census2022 resident composition, country of birth/origin and aliyah cohorts. Each percentage retains its own denominator; merged reporting areas count once. The snapshot excludes subsequent aliyah and cannot identify individual votes.

tools.name: search_polling_stations
tools.description: Published Knesset26 polling-building points, Hebrew addresses and Census2022 area assignments. Coordinates describe the building, not voter residence. Search by locality code, translated locality name, station label or published address.

tools.name: get_polling_station
tools.description: One station’s exact CEC identity, official published building point/address, aggregate result and independent census assignment; historical positions are not inferred.

tools.name: get_birth_country_population
tools.description: CBS table2.8: annual-average2023 national Jews and Others born abroad, by25 published countries/groups and8 age bands. Not Census2022, arrivals or city data. Russia/Ukraine stay within SU; US/Canada within NA_OC; source dashes are not invented zeros.
